notes: TOU periods per 沪发改价管〔2022〕50号 as restated in every monthly xls note 2: tou_rules are the 两部制 (大工业及一般工商业) schedule. 一般工商业单一制分时用户 use a 2-period schedule instead: 高峰 06:00-22:00, 低谷 22:00-06:00 (no 平/尖峰) — not stored as a tou_rule.
尖峰 (sharp): 7-8月 12:00-14:00 and 1、12月 19:00-21:00, 两部制 only; sharp = peak + 25% (on the floated base).

深谷 (deep_valley) per 沪发改价管〔2024〕28号: 大工业 (from 2026-08 the merged 两部制 class) on 元旦/春节/清明/劳动/端午/中秋/国庆 and on 休息日 (weekend rules) in 2-6月 and 9-11月, 00:00-06:00 and 22:00-24:00; price = 平段 base −80%. Holiday dates per the national notice.
Float base B = 代理购电价格 + 电度输配电价. 两部制: 夏(7-9)/冬(1,12) 峰 +80% 谷 −60%, other months 峰 +60% 谷 −50%; 单一制: 夏/冬 峰 +20% 谷 −45%, other months 峰 +17% 谷 −45%.
Category follows each month's table: up to 2026-07 一般工商业用电 (单一制/两部制) + 大工业用电 (两部制); from 2026-08 (4th TDP period) 工商业用电 单一制/两部制 only. 1.5倍 table (表3) not loaded.
